#!/bin/bash
# GitHub Workflow Monitor
# 工作流监控脚本

set -e

REPO="${1:-}"
FAILED_ONLY=false

# 解析参数
shift || true
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
        --failed-only)
            FAILED_ONLY=true
            shift
            ;;
        *)
            shift
            ;;
    esac
done

if [ -z "$REPO" ]; then
    echo "🔍 GitHub Workflow Monitor"
    echo ""
    echo "Usage: $0 [owner/repo] [--failed-only]"
    echo ""
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  --failed-only    仅显示失败的工作流"
    exit 1
